## What you'll get

::: {.highlight-box}
### Topics covered

- **R & Python tutorials** — hands-on geospatial workflows you can run yourself
- **Methods explainers** — how ML and AI approaches actually work on ecological data
- **Tool releases** — new versions of iLAND Workbench, forestPulse, and other packages
- **Research updates** — preprints, publications, and conference talks from The CEDAR Lab
:::
